operating_point.platform: CPU, GitHub runner 4 vCPU (probe/f3-fix-runaway), an arm a case and dtype
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: point_experiment: a 40 um sphere (150 um in light150) of 0.05 of water's density in the 1 mm periodic tube at D/h 16 driven at 1 m/s^2, the field's steady limit, dt 50 us; settled: offset 0.05 mm, 1500 steps; near_wall: offset 0.4 mm; pair: two 40 um bodies 2.5 radii apart along the axis; ownfield: gate 14's OWN_FIELD plant; neutral_imex: density 1, IMEX Euler, dt 0.2 ms; light_imex: density 0.05, IMEX Euler, dt 50 us; one pass unless the arm says lagged
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: deterministic, one run an arm, every step sampled

gate_runaway_series.claim: the rate load's size against the body's drag scale R0 (|V| + |u_d|) separates a runaway from a settled run: the settled arm's stays far below it in both dtypes, a runaway's passes it before the body's speed reaches ten times its settled value
gate_runaway_series.case: probe/series.py, an arm a case and dtype

prediction.unit: [guess] settled one pass: the share under 1e-6 in float64 at every step after 100 and under 1e-2 in float32; light150, near_wall and pair one pass in both dtypes: the share passes 1 within 70 steps (near_wall latest, about step 55); ownfield: the share passes 1 within 60 steps with no sign reversal at most steps; neutral_imex and light_imex: the share under 1 at every step and the reversing-and-growing count never 3
prediction.why: a settled body's rate load is the reading's noise (the solve's tolerance over dt); a runaway's grows geometrically from it until it drives the body

gate_runaway_series.metric: per step: |rate_load| / (R0 (|V| + |u_d|)), the reversing-and-growing count, the body's speed

control.plant: the physical arms neutral_imex and light_imex (no runaway): a criterion must stay quiet there

gate_runaway_series.if_wrong: a settled share near a runaway's at onset means the drag scale is not the drive to judge against: the criterion is then set on the body's energy against the work of its other loads
gate_runaway_series.cannot_discriminate_if: a runaway arm goes non-finite before it is sampled, or the settled arm runs away

gate_runaway_series.settled: one pass, 1500 steps: the share at most 6.1e-8 (float64) and 8.6e-5 (float32) after step 100, inside the predicted bands; the old flag raised at step 152 and 146 (the review's M3 reproduced)
gate_runaway_series.runaways: light150 non-finite at 39 (float64) and 32 (float32), the old flag at 24 and 16; near_wall non-finite at 111 and 123, flag at 28; pair bounded at about 7 m/s, flag at 18 and 19; the share passed 1 from step 2 in every arm (wrong: predicted at the onset, near step 55 for near_wall: the startup's rate load is already above the drag's scale), so the share alone cannot tell; the ringing above a share of 1e-2 fired at the old flag's steps in every runaway
gate_runaway_series.ownfield: the monotone runaway: ringing at most 1, the share above 1 throughout; no reversal-based criterion names it (as the PR said); gate 14's slip catches its plant
gate_runaway_series.physical arms: neutral_imex and light_imex never ring (as predicted) but their rate load grows above the drag's scale at startup (step 4, share up to 2.4): growth without the reversal false-alarms there, so the criterion keeps the reversal and adds the share
gate_runaway_series.verdict: the criterion chosen: the rate load reversing and growing for 3 steps, each above 1e-2 of R0 (|V| + |u_d|), one pass only (RATE_SHARE)
